subject: correction: SDL drivers in the Windows (Wine) SDL runs
finding: CrossOver's wine passes ordinary environment variables to Windows processes but drops SDL_* ones: `SDL_AUDIO_DRIVER=dummy NTSD_PROBE_VAR=hello wine cmd /c echo` printed 'audio=%SDL_AUDIO_DRIVER% probe=hello'
whatActuallyRan: SDL's default Windows drivers under Wine: a real (Mac-driver) window and WASAPI audio. The recorded results (state equal, text frames agreeing, the pair probe) came from those runs and remain valid observations; only the stated driver configuration was wrong. The earlier files are kept unchanged
howItShowed: with the Mac's screen locked (from 12:20) the matrix's Windows SDL run failed: the music player's stream reported 'WASAPI can't initialize audio client: Call failed.' and later scenarios stalled at 0% CPU
fix: NTSDSDL reads NTSD_SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER / NTSD_SDL_AUDIO_DRIVER and sets them as SDL hints before SDL_Init; matrix.py, check_windows_package.sh and pair_probe.py use them. Verified: Windows SDL with offscreen/dummy drivers under a locked screen, joystick scenario equal in 47 s, then all 10 scenarios 9/10 in the matrix
